name: svg-french-press-qwen3.8-27b-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 1160" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steelTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#cdd4db"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#98a2ad"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rodGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d3dae1"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#a7b1bc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7d8894"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef8fc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c4e2ef"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="9" height="9" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="9" height="9" fill="#e2e7ec"/>
      <path d="M0 0 H9 M0 4.5 H9" stroke="#98a3af" stroke-width="1"/>
      <path d="M0 0 V9 M4.5 0 V9" stroke="#98a3af" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="1160" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="450" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="27" font-weight="bold" fill="#111827" letter-spacing="3">FRENCH PRESS</text>
  <text x="450" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#6b7280">Exploded assembly diagram — parts separated along the assembly axis (top → bottom)</text>

  <!-- Assembly axis -->
  <line x1="370" y1="92" x2="370" y2="1105" stroke="#b6c2cc" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>

  <!-- ============ 1. LID KNOB ============ -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="152" rx="12" ry="4.5" fill="#2b3440"/>
    <rect x="358" y="128" width="24" height="24" fill="#4b5563"/>
    <rect x="336" y="104" width="68" height="26" rx="13" fill="#374151"/>
    <rect x="345" y="109" width="32" height="6" rx="3" fill="#6b7280"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 2. LID ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 236 252 L 192 218 L 202 211 C 210 228 223 240 241 247 Z" fill="#8b95a1" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="220" y="245" width="300" height="24" fill="#8b95a1"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="269" rx="150" ry="20" fill="#7d8894" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="245" rx="150" ry="20" fill="url(#steelTop)" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="245" rx="115" ry="14.5" fill="none" stroke="#6d7883" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="245" rx="24" ry="6.5" fill="#39424c"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 3. PLUNGER STEM ============ -->
  <g>
    <rect x="350" y="332" width="40" height="10" rx="4" fill="#6d7883"/>
    <rect x="363" y="342" width="14" height="150" fill="url(#rodGrad)" stroke="#6d7883" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="366" y="342" width="3" height="150" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>
    <rect x="338" y="492" width="64" height="12" rx="5" fill="#8a949f" stroke="#6d7883" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 4. MESH FILTER ============ -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="589" rx="140" ry="20" fill="#6d7883" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="230" y="585" width="280" height="4" fill="#6d7883"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="585" rx="140" ry="20" fill="#8a949f" stroke="#5b6570" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="585" rx="127" ry="15.5" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#6d7883" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 5. GLASS CARAFE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 210 692 C 212 770 232 845 252 872 L 488 872 C 508 845 528 770 530 692 Z"
          fill="url(#glassGrad)" fill-opacity="0.45" stroke="#6fa3bd" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M 252 712 C 248 768 258 818 272 848" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
    <path d="M 486 716 C 488 750 484 782 478 806" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="872" rx="118" ry="16" fill="#d9edf7" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="#6fa3bd" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="370" cy="692" rx="160" ry="20" fill="#eaf6fb" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="#6fa3bd" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M 222 700 C 205 690 192 672 186 652 L 197 645 C 203 664 215 680 233 690 Z" fill="#d5ebf6" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="#6fa3bd" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 6. STEEL FRAME & HANDLE ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- dashed silhouette: where the carafe sits inside the frame -->
    <rect x="252" y="962" width="236" height="104" rx="18" fill="none" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
    <rect x="225" y="952" width="310" height="13" rx="6.5" fill="#5b6570"/>
    <rect x="225" y="1072" width="310" height="13" rx="6.5" fill="#5b6570"/>
    <rect x="225" y="952" width="15" height="133" rx="7" fill="#5b6570"/>
    <rect x="520" y="952" width="15" height="133" rx="7" fill="#5b6570"/>
    <path d="M 533 985
             C 590 972 612 1000 610 1018
             C 608 1040 585 1062 533 1052
             L 533 1036
             C 570 1043 588 1030 590 1016
             C 592 1000 574 986 533 999 Z"
          fill="#5b6570"/>
    <circle cx="232" cy="958" r="2.5" fill="#2b3440"/>
    <circle cx="527" cy="958" r="2.5" fill="#2b3440"/>
    <circle cx="232" cy="1078" r="2.5" fill="#2b3440"/>
    <circle cx="527" cy="1078" r="2.5" fill="#2b3440"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ LABELS ============ -->
  <g font-size="15" fill="#1f2937">
    <!-- 1 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="129" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="133.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">1</text>
    <text x="164" y="134" text-anchor="end">Lid knob</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="129" x2="334" y2="122" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="334" cy="122" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>

    <!-- 2 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="258" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="262.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">2</text>
    <text x="164" y="263" text-anchor="end">Lid</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="258" x2="222" y2="257" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="222" cy="257" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>

    <!-- 3 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="415" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="419.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">3</text>
    <text x="164" y="420" text-anchor="end">Plunger stem</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="415" x2="361" y2="415" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="415" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>

    <!-- 4 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="585" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="589.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">4</text>
    <text x="164" y="590" text-anchor="end">Mesh filter</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="585" x2="232" y2="585" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="232" cy="585" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>

    <!-- 5 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="780" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="784.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">5</text>
    <text x="164" y="785" text-anchor="end">Glass carafe</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="780" x2="223" y2="780" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="223" cy="780" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>

    <!-- 6 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="1010" r="11" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <text x="180" y="1014.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">6</text>
    <text x="164" y="1015" text-anchor="end">Steel frame & handle</text>
    <line x1="196" y1="1010" x2="225" y2="1010" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="1010" r="2.5" fill="#64748b"/>
  </g>

  <text x="450" y="1135" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#94a3b8">6 parts · stack in the order shown to assemble</text>
</svg>
